valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E per ADR. Reported in EUR; 1 ADR = 1 ordinary share (ratio 1:1). EUR EPS converted at USD 1.1052 per EUR (ECB euro reference rate for 2026-11-13 as published by Banca d'Italia). Model: FY2027 net sales x gross margin less R&D+SG&A (opex) = operating income; x 0.85 (net income/operating income; Q3 2026 was about 0.86 excluding the EUR 510m equity-investment gain) = net income; / diluted shares (about 383m implied by Q3 net income EUR 4,960m / EUR 12.95 EPS, reduced for the EUR 2026-2028 buyback of about EUR 4.1bn per quarter) = EUR EPS per share = per ADR; x 1.1052 = USD EPS per ADR; x P/E applied to FY2027 EPS at the Nov-2027 target date. Base: sales EUR 56bn (+26% on the FY2026 guide of EUR 44-45bn), gross margin 57.5%, opex EUR 7.0bn, 374m shares = EUR 57.3 = USD 63.3. Dividends excluded (price-only; interim 2026 dividend EUR 1.88 per share).

bear.driver: AI/memory capex digestion: FY2027 sales EUR 46bn (+3% on FY2026), gross margin 53%, opex EUR 6.9bn, 376m shares
bear.assumption: EPS EUR 39.5 = USD 43.7 per ADR at 20x

base.driver: Q4 2026 guide (EUR 14.2-15.2bn, GM ~57%) carries over; planned +30% 2027 capacity partly shipped: FY2027 sales EUR 56bn, GM 57.5%
base.assumption: EPS EUR 57.3 = USD 63.3 per ADR at 28x

bull.driver: Supply-constrained demand through 2027-28 (company says supply will not fully meet demand): FY2027 sales EUR 65bn, GM 59%, opex EUR 7.4bn, 372m shares
bull.assumption: EPS EUR 71.6 = USD 79.1 per ADR at 32x

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of USD 63.3 the close implies 23.6x; the analyst-weighted target (about USD 2,450) implies about 38.7x, or about USD 87.5 (EUR 79) EPS at 28x, roughly 38% above the model
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by USD 63 (4.2 pp of the close); EUR 1bn of FY2027 sales at 57.5% GM moves EPS about EUR 1.3 and the target about USD 40
valuation.watch_metric: Net system bookings and FY2027 sales/gross-margin outlook: base case needs FY2027 sales near EUR 56bn at about 57.5% gross margin
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results, expected late January 2027 (date to be confirmed by ASML), with the first 2027 outlook

analyst_notes: Eleven dated rows from five named analysts covering Bernstein, BofA, Wells Fargo, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley; all rate Buy-equivalent and every target except BofA's October 6 raise predates the October 14 Q3 release, so most are 4-5 months old and no 12-month horizon is documented. Targets of USD 2,000-2,900 against the USD 1,495 close imply 24x-39x on the base EPS; BofA's CY2028 EPS of EUR 85.2 and Bernstein's 2028 EPS of EUR 67 plus a 40x multiple show the gap is mostly a much higher earnings path and multiple than the base case (EUR 57 FY2027 at 28x). Citigroup (USD 2,300), HSBC (USD 2,261), Jefferies (USD 1,590) and a JPMorgan trim to USD 2,350 appear in a 2026-11-16 article but their dates could not be verified before the close, so they are excluded. Morgan Stanley's EUR 1,830 (prior EUR 1,660) is converted at 1.1052 for comparability; BofA's USD 2,915 is the ADR equivalent of EUR 2,557 stated by the source.
